migrations.20261025_token_prices_per_mil: Migrate system model prices to million units

Reads system models once and saves pricing in one batch. Token/TTS rates are multiplied by 1000; STT rates are copied unchanged. Preserves root-level prices and skips valid existing pricing. Team models are free. Runs in the background; fix invalid data and retry after a failure.

Once removal succeeds, count existing Dataset vectors in the background and schedule FP16 partial indexes for Datasets with more than 10,000 vectors. Index jobs run without a delay, one at a time globally. Migration completion does not mean all partial indexes are ready. Exact search remains available while indexes are being built.

migrations.20261120_migrate_model_pricin: Runs independently in the background in stages after startup: first backfills legacy STT pricing types as duration-based, then converts system LLM tier maxInputTokens bounds from M Tokens to positive integer K Tokens (skipping bounds > 10), and validates all model pricing.
Scanned {{sttModels}} STT models and converted tier limits to K Tokens for {{llmModels}} system LLM models.
migrations.20261110_migrate_sql_fulltext: Confirm that all App/Pro nodes are upgraded, legacy training jobs have drained, and the SQL vector database supports full-text search before running. With pg_search below 0.26.0, vector writes wait and may time out while PostgreSQL first builds or rebuilds the index. To avoid timeouts, pause all Dataset vector writes and let in-flight writes finish before starting or retrying. Resume when the Prepare full-text schema and index step completes. The migration validates source records, backfills historical tokens in batches, and succeeds after all final checks pass. With TMP_MIGRATE_FULL_TEXT=true, reads stay on Mongo and both stores receive writes after migration succeeds. Remove the variable and restart to switch to native SQL full-text search. For confirmed missing vector rows, the migration uses the Dataset's embedding model to rebuild vectors and full-text tokens, then replaces only the missing vector references. It skips FastGPT point checks and deductions.
